text: Independent evidence from Earth observation supports the 2021 tree-cover loss claim. The Hansen Global Forest Change dataset (GFC-2025-v1.13) detected 81.3 hectares of stand-replacing tree-cover loss within the asset in 2021, meeting the minimum event area threshold of 0.5 hectares. This observation is corroborated by the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 (GFC2020 V4) reference map, which confirms that 98% of the affected area was forested in 2020. Additionally, Uruguay’s MGAP 2021 forest map identifies the area as planted forest (68.1 ha of *Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*), with no native forest present. The loss is spatially and temporally consistent across these independent datasets, confirming the event occurred within the claimed period and scope.
